datasets.name: Landslide label (historical landslide record, interpretations of satellite images and field survey data)
datasets.source: Headquarters for the prevention and control of geo-hazards in the Three Gorges Reservoir area
datasets.verbatim: The landslide label was constructed by using historical landslide record, interpretations of satellite images and field survey data which provided by the Headquarters for the prevention and control of geo-hazards in the Three Gorges Reservoir area.

datasets.name: ZY-3 satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: The high-resolution image comes from the ZY-3 satellite, 4 bands, with a resolution of 5.8 m, acquired in April 2013.

datasets.name: Environmental conditions (geological, topographic, hydrological and land cover factors)
datasets.source: Geological maps, geographic information databases and remote sensing images
datasets.verbatim: These factors used in the experiments can be divided into four categories, and their sources are given in Table II.

methods.name: DenseNet-BC
methods.summary: A modified DenseNet architecture (DenseNet-BC) with 158 layers, incorporating bottleneck layers, transition layers, and dilation convolution to improve feature extraction and receptive field for landslide detection. The model is trained using a combination of optical imagery and 12 environmental factors, with data augmentation and fine-tuning optimization.
methods.source: Haojie Cai, Tao Chen, Ruiqing Niu, and Antonio Plaza
methods.verbatim: All source code is programmed using the Python language under the deep learning framework TensorFlow.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned without links or persistent references, and the custom code for the DenseNet-BC model is not provided.
